## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Explain checks you could not run.
For UI changes, attach light/dark screenshots and mention keyboard/narrow-window checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the README reflects any setup or behavior changes.
- [ ] Relevant behavior has regression coverage, or this is documentation/formatting only.
- [ ] No private documents, database files, credentials or model weights are included.
- [ ] Local inference, path confinement and the Docker startup workflow are preserved.
